title: Lunar Modulator clip
description: One clip as movy1 lines at track 0 and slot 0: the au lines of the lanes its locks use, then its cl, cp, lk and tg lines. Loaded into a track and slot the user picks; lanes match by label (notes/2026-10-06-state-files.md §10.2). Suggested file name: bass-a.clip.lunar.
